description: The system shall allow users to access the portal through personal credential authentication.
Upon entering valid credentials, the system shall authenticate the user and grant access to the portal functionalities.
The system shall display a list of applications to which the authenticated user has access.
The system shall only show the applications for which the user has authorized access.
The system shall allow users to access the applications available in the portal.
If the user has access to only one application, the system shall redirect them to that application's main page; if multiple, the user shall select the desired application.
The system shall restrict data visualization and actions (create, modify, delete) based on the user's assigned roles.
The system shall verify user roles and permissions upon accessing the Commercial Cloud data management application and permit or deny actions accordingly.
The system shall ensure that users cannot access data belonging to other clients.
The system shall verify the client associated with the user and only display data belonging to that specific client.
The system shall convert any mention of the old name to the new name.
The new name shall be displayed in all locations where the old name was previously mentioned.
The system shall allow administrators to assign or revoke application access for users.
Upon administrator update, the system shall modify the user's application list, reflecting the changes upon the user's next login.
The new content must maintain visual coherence with the design of the old version of the application.
Design, colors, fonts, and organization must be consistent with the old version.
The system must be easy to use for any user.
80% of users shall not need to ask for third-party help to use the application.
The application must be available in several languages.
Translations must be complete and correct in both languages.
The user must be able to perform new operations without special training.
The learning time for new functionalities should not exceed 5 minutes.
Query operations must have a load time of less than 1 second.
Response time must not exceed 1 second in 95% of queries.
The web application must guarantee continuous and stable operation, ensuring its availability at all times.
System availability must be at least 99.9%, even during periods of intensive use.
The web application must support a large number of concurrent users without degrading its performance.
System availability must be at least 99.9%, even during periods of intensive use.
The system must allow the creation, consultation, modification, and deletion of data for authorized users.
The system must have a secure authentication and permission verification mechanism to ensure each user only accesses authorized information and functionalities.
The application must manage a strict separation of data for each client.
No user can access data belonging to other clients.
